strategy.thesis: Venture studio (venture builder) founded by Andrew Ng that co-founds AI companies rather than investing in existing ones, combining deep AI expertise, market validation and hands-on talent acquisition. The Taiwan hub is a base from which AI Fund and portfolio companies grow their presence in Asia and build new AI startups with Taiwan's corporations and tech community.

summary.en: AI Fund is a Palo Alto-based AI venture studio founded by Andrew Ng that co-founds AI companies. In Oct 2024 it announced a Taiwan hub (led by GM Jill Shih) as its Asia base to build new AI startups with Taiwan's tech ecosystem. It closed an oversubscribed $190M Fund II in 2025, following a $175M Fund I, and has co-founded around 35 companies.
summary.local: AI Fund 是由 Andrew Ng 創辦、總部位於矽谷 Palo Alto 的 AI 創業工作室（venture studio），與創業者共同創辦 AI 公司。2024 年 10 月宣布設立台灣分部（由 Jill Shih 擔任總經理）作為亞洲基地，與台灣科技生態系共建 AI 新創。2025 年完成超額認購的 1.9 億美元第二檔基金（第一檔 1.75 億美元），累計共同創辦約 35 家公司。

strategy.thesis: Government co-investment program run by Taiwan's Ministry of Digital Affairs (MODA) with the National Development Fund. Invests alongside private 'matching investors' (financial institutions, VCs, accelerators, CVCs) in domestic AI startups and digital-economy firms, at a default 1:1 (up to 2:1) public-to-private ratio, to build Taiwan's AI ecosystem and create new unicorns.

investment.raw: 單次上限 1億元 / 單一企業最高 1.5億元

program.eligibility: Companies registered in Taiwan; non-listed; no mainland China (PRC/HK/Macau) capital; in digital-economy sectors (software, infosec, e-commerce, gaming, fintech, etc.)

application.how_to_apply: Enterprises apply for fundraising via investai.org.tw; private 'matching investors' (創投/加速器/CVC) apply to partner with the fund

summary.en: A 10-year, NT$10 billion government co-investment program launched March 2025 by Taiwan's Ministry of Digital Affairs (Administration for Digital Industries) with the National Development Fund. It invests in domestic AI and digital-economy startups alongside private 'matching investors' (VCs, accelerators, CVCs) at a 1:1 (up to 2:1) ratio, capped at NT$100M per round and NT$150M per company, with a 7-year investment / 3-year exit structure.
summary.local: 由數位發展部數位產業署偕同國發基金於 2025 年 3 月推出的 10 年期、新台幣 100 億元政府搭配投資方案。與民間「搭配投資人」（創投、加速器、企業創投）以 1:1（最高 2:1）比例共同投資國內 AI 與數位經濟新創，單次投資上限 1 億元、單一企業最高 1.5 億元，採投資期 7 年、處分期 3 年。

strategy.thesis: An AI accelerator jointly launched by StarFab and NVIDIA Inception, supported by Taiwan's National Development Council. Provides business mentorship and AI hardware-software enablement plus an early-stage NT$3M SAFE investment, targeting high-growth Taiwanese AI startups across digital twin, robotics, AI agents and intelligent healthcare.

application.how_to_apply: Via StarFab / NVIDIA Inception Taiwan program

summary.en: TAI1 (TAI One) is an AI accelerator jointly launched by StarFab and NVIDIA Inception in 2025, supported by Taiwan's National Development Council. Selected AI startups receive business mentorship, AI hardware/software enablement and an early-stage NT$3 million SAFE investment from ITIC. Its inaugural cohort included a delegation of 16 Taiwanese AI startups showcased at NVIDIA GTC 2026.
summary.local: TAI1（TAI One）是由 StarFab 與 NVIDIA Inception 於 2025 年共同推出、獲國家發展委員會支持的 AI 加速器。獲選 AI 新創可獲得商業輔導、AI 軟硬體資源，以及由工業技術投資公司（ITIC）提供的新台幣 300 萬元 SAFE 早期投資。首屆並率 16 家台灣 AI 新創於 NVIDIA GTC 2026 展示。
